description: This file defines a UI component named 'Header' for a shopping app frontend, using Lightning.js framework. It includes visual layout, styling, and computed properties for display.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A Lightning.js component representing the header section of the shopping app, displaying the shop name, cart item count, and total price.

methods.name: itemsLabel
methods.description: Computes and returns the label for the number of items in the cart, e.g., '3 items'.

methods.name: totalLabel
methods.description: Computes and returns the total price formatted as a dollar amount, e.g., '$99.99'.
